transcript: Speaker A: English bolte time blank ho jate ho? [Do you go blank while speaking English?] Speaker B: Haan yaar, sab samajh aata hai, par jab bolne ki bari aati hai to dimaag se shabd gayab ho jate hain. [Yes, I understand everything, but when speaking, words disappear.] Speaker A: Kyunki bolne ki aadat nahi hai. Speakeasy app pe aao aur roj 15 minute mere sath akele practice karo. [Because you lack practice. Practice 15 minutes daily with me on Speakeasy.] Speaker B: Sahi hai, yahan bina kisi sharm ke practice ho jayegi. [Great, I can practice here without embarrassment.] Speaker A: Bilkul, main tumhara mazak nahi udaungi, sirf tumhari English behtar banaungi. [Absolutely, I won't judge, just improve your English.] Speaker C: Abhi Speakeasy app download karein aur farratedar English bolna shuru karein. [Download Speakeasy now and speak fluent English.]
on_screen_text: English Bolte Time Blank Ho Jate Ho. [Do you go blank while speaking English?] Haan Yaar, Sab Samajh Ata Hai... [Yes, I understand everything...] Speakeasy AI. Speak English Easily with SpeakEasy. Install Now.
summary: The ad addresses the fear of speaking English despite understanding it. An AI avatar invites a user to practice daily on the Speakeasy app without judgment. The CTA encourages downloading the app for fluent English.
